definitions.explanation: Indicates that a building or architectural structure is currently being constructed. Commonly seen on signs at construction sites.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{建築中|けんちくちゅう}です。
{建築中|けんちくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Apartment buildings under construction are increasing in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {建築中|けんちくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になっています。
examples.english: Due to construction, this road is closed to traffic.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ (architecture, construction of buildings) + ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in the middle of, during). Specifically refers to the construction of buildings and structures, as opposed to ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ which covers all types of construction work including road work and repairs.

The suffix ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ attaches to many nouns to indicate an ongoing state: ⟦{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}→営業中：09539_eigyouchuu⟧ (open for business), ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧ (in preparation), ⟦{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}→修理中：20768_shuurichuu⟧ (under repair).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建築中|けんちくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: building under construction
- {建築中|けんちくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧: apartment building under construction
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{建築中|けんちくちゅう}: currently under construction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧: under construction/repair — broader, includes road work, renovations, repairs
- ⟦{建設中|けんせつちゅう}→建設中：22326_kensetsuchuu⟧: under construction — very similar, slightly more formal; used for large-scale projects
- ⟦{改装中|かいそうちゅう}→改装中：24572_kaisouchuu⟧: under renovation — for remodeling existing structures
